usefulness.rationale: The dossier contains no content: no dossier entries and no retained sources. A reader learns only the identity anchor (IBM chairman/CEO, IIT Kanpur and University of Illinois EE graduate) plus confusable namesakes. Nothing can be assessed about what Krishna actually did, what the dossier acknowledges not knowing, or meeting preparation. No dossier statements with citations exist, so no overclaims can be matched to specific citations, even though two unjustified conclusions (sole-inventor, personal-acquisition) are flagged against absent content.
